name: health-evidence-companion
description: Evidence-based medical and adult psychological education with separate private-record workflows.

interface.longDescription: Fifteen skills combine medical education, medicines, prevention, family care, research and private medical history with adult psychological dialogue, CBT/ACT/MCT self-help, relationships, sport preparation and separate psychological notes. Existing health-* and psyops-* skill names are retained. The library preserves 250 medical and 102 psychology source records, their original IDs, reading dates and access limitations; a domain-qualified catalog links overlaps. Optional offline imports, graphs, genetics and owner-selected Psychology summaries reuse bundled helpers. Full medical records and psychological journals remain separate; neither installation nor authorization for one archive grants access to the other. No publisher backend, patient telemetry, automatic account access, therapist qualification, medical clearance or validated AI treatment is provided. Host and chosen storage controls apply. Clinical guidance and consequential genetic findings need current sources and clinical confirmation.
capabilities: Discuss optional CBT, ACT and MCT practices
defaultPrompt: Help me understand this health concern and prepare clinician questions.
Help me reflect on this difficulty or choose an optional psychological practice.
Review this public study and prepare a knowledge pull request.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.6.0 combines Health and PsyOps in one 15-skill package. Medical and psychological records retain separate scopes; an optional Psychology sidebar accepts owner-selected summaries only. Original source records, reading limits, blank forms and skill names are preserved, with a domain-qualified catalog and offline review queue. No personal archives are migrated or disclosed automatically.
